in_marathi.name: Dhanu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Bow, Vehicle of Lord Shiva
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhanu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Dhanu refers to the divine bow of Lord Shiva. It is a symbol of power, strength, and protection. The name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'dhanu' which means bow.
